programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight #1285 DC-8 December 12th, 1985 - After a six-month peace-keeping mission in the Middle East, 248 elite American soldiers are on their way home for the holidays. Destined for Fort Campbell, Kentucky, they are travelling on Arrow Air Flight #1285, a charter air carrier contracted by the military to transport troops. En route from Cairo, the DC-8 eventually touches down for a routine refueling stop in Gander, Newfoundland. But just seconds after taking off again for the last leg of its journey, the plane loses airspeed and altitude and crashes into a heavily wooded area just south of the runway. An unprecedented disaster, it is one of the deadliest aviation accidents of all time and the resulting investigation ignites a storm of controversy that continues to this day.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Earth protects itself from the sun. The David and Goliath story of Earths relationship with its greatest threat, our seemingly benign Sun. The Sun is the big violent boss of the Solar System throwing out devastating particles and deadly radiation. Without several shields, one generated by our unique planetary core, another by our atmosphere, and a third by our interconnected weather systems, life on Earth would never have survived.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Earth gives birth to life. The building blocks of life are common across the universe, but life is rare. What's so special about Earth that it emerged here? Only here on Earth have we found the elixir of life; water in its three forms. But for life to emerge this isn't enough… huge tides created by the proximity of our perfect Moon, plate tectonics, volcanoes and lightning mean the Earth is a dynamic planet. It's a huge planetary chemical experiment, a bubbling cauldron that transforms dead minerals into deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA); the code for all life.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Ever since life emerged, microbes, plants and animals have all sculpted the planets surface and atmosphere in the strangest of ways; fish poop creates islands; dead animals create mountains; plants help create continents. From rocks to rivers, life has crafted everything that makes our planet so special. But this power of change brings with it profound dangers. Life doesnt just create. It can also destroy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think you understand the colors you see every day? Think an apple is actually red, or a leaf is really green? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your brain to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that will reveal a shocking truth—color is just an illusion created by your brain. We'll show you how some colors can make you fly, reveal ghostly colors that don't actually exist, and if you play along you'll see how color helps keep you alive.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on a 1989 VW Golf GTi, one of the most iconic cars to have come out of the 1980s and one which just happens to be Tim Shaw's all-time favourite car. The boys challenge this time is to make this particular Golf suitable for its owner Darren, a former bus driver who was left disabled and partially sighted after a tragic road accident in which he saved the life of his young grandson.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Forfar in Scotland to rescue the rusting wreck of a rare Talbot Sunbeam Lotus. The car was the pride and joy of former firefighter, and lifelong rally enthusiast, Jim who had planned to restore it, however a back injury not only forced him to give up his job but also any plans to get his car back on the road. Once the boys get the car back in the workshop they discover they have something very special on their hands as the Talbot turns out to be an ultra-rare factory proto type.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Kent to try and salvage a 1991 VW T4 Campervan. The vehicle belongs to 42 year old carpenter Jon who bought his mobile home several year ago with the dream of taking his wife travelling around the world. Sadly before Jon's dream came true he was diagnosed with brain cancer, his whole world ground to a halt and his plans to restore and drive his beloved van had to go on hold. Will the Car SOS team be able to help resurrect Jon's dream?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Derbyshire to rescue a 48 year old Italian supercar: a 1971 Lamborghini Espada. This remarkable car belongs to lifelong petrol head Ged who bought the car in 1977 for $4000 however when it eventually broke down Ged's aim of one day restoring it to its former glory ground to a halt when serious health issues got in the way. Will the boys from Car SOS be able to make Ged's dream come true?

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam attracts 24 million tourists every year. The capital is one of Europe's leading tourist destinations. Visitors come to Amsterdam not only for the Rijksmuseum or its 165 picturesque canals, but many also for its 165 coffeeshops. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran assist an American tourist who has fallen ill after using soft drugs. At the Ticket & Service department, Alexandra makes a game of guessing which country travelers come from. In the Lost & Found department, staff member Gusta searches for a missing backpack belonging to an American tourist. Tourists from the United Kingdom arrive at Amsterdam Central Station by high-speed train. At the dedicated UK Terminal, the team races against the clock to ensure the train to London departs on time.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Festival season has kicked off in the city, culminating in the Amsterdam Dance Event, the world's largest electronic music festival. Around 500,000 dance enthusiasts from around the world are gathering in Amsterdam to attend the festivities. This means tens of thousands of extra passengers at the station. Safety & Service staff Menno and Baran are busy dealing with visitors who are using drugs excessively. Veteran Menno tries to keep his new colleague Baran in check when he chases a troublemaker who is under the influence. Amsterdam Central is also joining in the festivities, with various stages and a special Dance Train featuring a DJ. On board, conductor Errol is transported back to his time as a party animal.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. At the Fort Lauderdale Airport, U.S. Customs and Border Protection seizes over a thousand hydrocodone pills from an airline pilot returning from Colombia. At Atlanta International Airport, CBP consults with archaeologists to verify the authenticity of several artifacts they suspect were looted.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: CBP officers in the Port of Savannah intercept a suspiciously heavy shipping container bound for Ghana — and it's full of stolen cars. Officers at New Orleans International Airport question a man arriving from Honduras, after the K-9 enforcement team flags his suitcase as potentially containing narcotics. In Florida, Air and Marine Operations agents patrol a smuggling hotspot, as they search for jettisoned contraband.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight #1285 DC-8 December 12th, 1985 - After a six-month peace-keeping mission in the Middle East, 248 elite American soldiers are on their way home for the holidays. But just seconds after taking off again for the last leg of its journey, the plane loses airspeed and altitude and crashes into a heavily wooded area just south of the runway. An unprecedented disaster, it is one of the deadliest aviation accidents of all time and the resulting investigation ignites a storm of controversy that continues to this day.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Continental Express Flight #2574 Embraer 120 Brasilia On its second routine trip of the morning, Continental Express Flight #2574 is nearing the end of its one-hour flight from Laredo to Houston, Texas. A state-of-the-art Embraer 120 Brasilia, the commuter plane is scheduled to make several more short flights. But just as the pilots are preparing for descent, the plane falls out of the sky. Dropping thousands of feet in mere seconds, there is a massive explosion as the aircraft crashes into a farmer's field. All 14 people on board die in the disaster, and the impact is so violent that the wreckage is barely recognizable as an airplane. Investigators consider that there was a bomb on board, but when the theory is dismissed, they dig deeper and eventually reveal a chilling story of good intentions gone horribly wrong.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: On a routine flight from Surabaya, Indonesia, to Hong Kong, Cathay 780 experienced unexplained engine warnings. Over the course of its journey, both engines failed, turning the plane into a glider. Capt. Malcolm Waters uses his piloting skills to guide the plane towards Hong Kong and avoid ditching in the sea. When one engine regains partial power, hope rekindles, but now the speed is stuck. The struggling plane approaches Hong Kong for a high-speed landing. When a plane comes to a stop at the end of the runway, a brake fire triggers an emergency evacuation. The engine shutdown remained a mystery until investigators discovered an unusual source: the fuel. A storm near Surabaya's airport caused fuel contamination, leading the engines to stall. In this episode, Capt. Waters recounts his nail-biting experience in the cockpit.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: A routine flight from London Heathrow to Belfast International Airport ended in tragedy when British Midland Flight 92 crashed onto a motorway embankment near the town of Kegworth on 8th January 1989. An engine failure meant the crew would have to make what should have been a straightforward emergency landing. Tragically, the pilots mistakenly identified and shut-off the wrong engine, leading to a catastrophic crash near the M1. In this episode, survivors give us their first-hand account of the horrific accident..

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most notorious unsolved skyjackings and missing person cases…and new evidence is leading the FBI to reopen their files with the belief it might finally be solved. The night before Thanksgiving, 1971, a man by the name of Dan Cooper boarded Northwest Orient Airlines flight 305 from Portland to Seattle. Several hours later, with $200,000 strapped to his body, he leapt from the plane - and into history. A reporter botched the name of the culprit, and D.B. Cooper was born. A collection of suspects and clues have emerged - a copycat crime, a bag full of Cooper's bills discovered in 1980, a deathbed confessional - but all leads have proven inconclusive. But the past year or so has seen a flurry of new clues. In 2007, new evidence emerged from a man who claims that his deceased brother - a Northwest employee and Army paratrooper - was the real D.B. Cooper. Then, in March 2008, a parachute turned up on a field where Cooper could have landed that matched the one he used. Meanwhile, new evidence released by the FBI in the past few months is generating new theories - and suspects. As the FBI reopens the case, we'll follow the same evidence trail to find out if this new information could finally bring this notorious case to a close.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. Yet decades after the fact, certain stories remain touched by an air of uncertainty. Investigate the truth behind some of history's greatest events and most iconic people. Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. programme.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Bertie is in Canada for his most remote and challenging mission yet; filming a wolf pack taking on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: From "The Lion King" director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Overhalla, Jo Roger's under pressure when a crashed truck blocks the main road north-south. With no alternative routes, the crash cuts Norway in two. In the south, a truck parked up for the night starts sliding on sheet ice. During the rescue, Thord discovers that the accident could have been much worse, because the truck was close to careering down a steep bank when the driver was asleep. Thord's young recruit Gabriel also gets a shock during his first solo mission. Called out to rescue a car that's slammed into a cliff face, he realises that the car is a write-off - but is then surprised to find the four occupants in party mood.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: Growing up, David Blaine was fascinated by images from India of extraordinary physical feats. This evolved into a life-long obsession with real performances so extreme they appear to be magical. Using secrets passed down over hundreds of years, people still perform these acts today. David unearths these modern practitioners to explore how belief and performance intersect to make magic.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In the stunning frozen landscape of the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity's curiously extreme ability to endure freezing temperatures. He meets and learns from people who reach beyond their limits to transform barriers into new frontiers and embody a sense of resilience, perseverance and grit that is unique to the region.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In a nation once defined by apartheid, David embarks on an epic adventure in South Africa, uncovering the magic of its diverse cultures and wildlife that is reshaping perceptions and dismantling barriers in this dynamic country.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether you're a left-handed artist or a right-handed accountant, we all use both sides of our brains. But is there any science behind the notion that the left half or our brain is the creative side while the right half is more logical? In this episode about your left and right brain, we're going to put you through a series of games and experiments designed to find out how the two sides operate, what they really control, and whether or not one side of your brain dominates the other.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether its remembering where you parked the car, or just finding the light switch in the morning, navigating your busy world can be tough. Luckily your brain has a built-in navigation system to help make sense of your surroundings. In fact, recent discoveries prove that the brain uses place cells and direction cells to help get us to where were going. In this episode we explore spatial awareness. Its how your brain tells you where you are. Through a series of games and experiments well test the boundaries of your brains hardwired sense of direction, and prove how you arent always aware of your surroundings or even your body. Plus youll learn a surprising technique to enhance your spatial memory.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and how it perceives motion. Evolving in a world that is constantly moving, the human brain had to develop a pretty sophisticated sense of motion in order to survive. This episode stops to ask some deceptively simple questions-What really is motion? Is the movement that you see real? Or is the wiring of your brain's motion detectors merely being fooled? We explore the science behind how your brain detects and interprets motion, and you'll see how easily this hard-wiring can be fooled... for better and for worse.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: This time, Tim and Fuzz are in unknown territory as they take on 28-year-old Charlie's Lexus IS200 and transform it into a full-blown drift car. Trainee bus driver Charlie had always dreamed of taking up the sport of drifting, sadly when he contracted cancer, his dreams went out the window. The Car SOS boys are going to have to go on a steep learning curve to stand a chance of pulling this one off.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Making motoring dreams come true for a fifth season Car SOS is back, and this time it's bigger and better than ever. Everyone's favourite petrol heads Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw continue their mission to seek out classic cars with deserving owners. Using all their guile and restoration knowledge their aim is to sneak away clapped out classics without their owners knowing then in a blizzard of grease and grime and hard graft get the much loved motors back where they deserve to be, on the road. In this series the boys take on their biggest challenges ever. Chronic rust, hard to find parts and broken engines test the boys to their limits. British classics, Italian roadsters, German grand tourers and French hot hatches from across seven decades of motoring history make the most astonishing line-up Car SOS has ever had, and, for their lucky owners the surprise they will never forget.

programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: April 19, 1995, begins like any other in Oklahoma City, until a bomb explodes outside a federal building. Oklahomans are plunged into chaos, and first responders race against the clock to save those trapped inside. Meanwhile, the media search for answers, and the FBI begins what will be their biggest investigation yet.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programme.desc: A groundbreaking look at the infamous Stanford Prison Experiment, through the first-hand accounts of the original prisoners and guards. Their stories unravel a new narrative that interrogates the motives of the man pulling the strings, Dr. Philip Zimbardo, while exploring larger questions of human nature and the power of perspective. Utilizing Rashomon-style reenactments and an Act of Killing-inspired reunion component, the project brings the layers of storytelling to unexpected levels.

programme.title: Notre Dame: Race Against the Inferno
programme.desc: On 15th April 2019, during Holy Monday Mass, the world's most famous cathedral caught fire. Notre-Dame de Paris was ablaze in minutes, as an epic battle unfolded for heroic French firefighters. Under the gaze of the world's media, they fought the inferno for more than 15 hours. Exclusive footage and interviews bring vividly to life the moment-by-moment courage of the Paris fire and police services, as they put their lives on the line to save this historic building.

programme.title: X-Ray Earth
programme.desc: Beneath our feet, under trillions of tons of rock, lurk astonishing and deadly secrets. Earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions are all driven by hidden forces deep inside our planet. Now, using the latest scientific data from sensors and surface scans, we can x-ray the earth to reveal the dangers locked inside our planet.Using thousands of sensors and state of the art surface scan information, for the first time, we can create x-rays of the deep interior of our planet.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: New Orleans' resilient residents exit the city, forming part of the Katrina diaspora. As they navigate the uncertainty of how and when they might restore their lives, a plan for a new New Orleans takes shape. The future of the devastated city hangs in the balance as its residents struggle to return, rebuild and restart their lives even 20 years later.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Access 360° World Heritage
programme.desc: The city of Venice attracts millions of tourist each year with its rich historic and artistic heritage. Behind the beautiful and vibrant facade, lies a city in grave danger. The Adriatic Sea that brought fortune and glory to the city is also a threat to Venice and its lagoon. When the sirens go off, Venetians brace themselves for an incoming attack. The tide rises, floodwater rushes into the city and destroys every artwork or architecture in its path. Expert teams of Engineers, Scientists and Conservators are determined to save this UNESCO World Heritage site from vanishing beneath the waves.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Mysterious structures on an abandoned Italian island reveal a dark past. An exploration of Japan's Battleship Island reveals a troubled history. Strange trees on the Yemeni island of Socotra are examined. On Indonesia's Flores Island, an unusual skull is found in a cave.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Abandoned structures and machinery on an island near Antarctica point to brief human settlements. Disturbing noises heard by foreign diplomats in Cuba set off research on a possible global psychological phenomenon. Mysterious rubber-like slabs from Indonesia appear on European beaches. A strange stone pattern found in the waters of Florida's Dry Tortugas National Park reveals a long-lost island.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Enormous ancient terraces made of volcanic rocks in West Java, Indonesia, have origins shrouded in mystery. Hundreds of human skeletal remains unearthed on the island of St. Helena reveal a dark and sorrowful past. In the Persian gulf, a blood-red beach on Hormuz Island ignites wild speculation. Mysterious penguin remains are discovered in a place beyond the reach of these short-legged creatures.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Overhalla, Jo Roger's under pressure when a crashed truck blocks the main road north-south. With no alternative routes, the crash cuts Norway in two. In the south, a truck parked up for the night starts sliding on sheet ice. During the rescue, Thord discovers that the accident could have been much worse, because the truck was close to careering down a steep bank when the driver was asleep. Thord's young recruit Gabriel also gets a shock during his first solo mission. Called out to rescue a car that's slammed into a cliff face, he realises that the car is a write-off - but is then surprised to find the four occupants in party mood.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. A woman is caught trafficking cocaine inside packets of hair bleach. When she's hit with a dramatic fainting spell, officers fear the worst. Agents uncover nearly three kilos of cocaine inside photos of the Pope. And a man who attempted to run from police is arrested, his luggage lined with cocaine.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat: cocaine smuggling. Police arrest a woman carrying a load of small purses packed cocaine, but she claims she's innocent. When the agents bring in her boyfriend, she erupts in anger. Agents uncover 3 kilos of cocaine disguised as bleaching powder. A woman hides cocaine in her undergarments, but she may be carrying more elsewhere.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. Agents arrest two different traffickers with bricks of cocaine branded in the same curious way. One of those loads is among the largest of the last few years. Panicked asylum seekers refuse to cooperate, causing an uproar. And suitcases carrying hundreds of counterfeit goods are intercepted.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: CBP officers in the Port of Savannah intercept a suspiciously heavy shipping container bound for Ghana — and it's full of stolen cars. Officers at New Orleans International Airport question a man arriving from Honduras, after the K-9 enforcement team flags his suitcase as potentially containing narcotics. In Florida, Air and Marine Operations agents patrol a smuggling hotspot, as they search for jettisoned contraband.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. At the Fort Lauderdale Airport, U.S. Customs and Border Protection seizes over a thousand hydrocodone pills from an airline pilot returning from Colombia. At Atlanta International Airport, CBP consults with archaeologists to verify the authenticity of several artifacts they suspect were looted.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Paranatural investigates the disappearances of ships and planes in the area known as the Bermuda Triangle. Some believe theres something amiss in this patch of sea, but tales of the Triangle are the stuff of legend, roundly dismissed by skeptics as tragic, but explainable disappearances. Most scientists arent interested in the Bermuda Triangle, but there is a different mysterious area hovering just above the Earth that has gotten their attention.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: What happens when we die? Is there an afterlife? Does human consciousness survive physical death? These are some of the most baffling questions known to humankind. Nearly every culture and religion seems to believe in some form of "Life after Life." Some people who have been near death report being bathed in images, sounds and feelings so vivid and so real that their lives are changed forever. But are these experiences real, or is it all just a strange last gasp of the human brain?

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Atlantis, the legendary island believed to have sunk beneath the waves thousands of years ago, has puzzled the academic community for generations. Though many sites have been put forward, the Atlantis described by the philosopher Plato remains a mystery. The Truth Behind Atlantis aims to dive into the murky depths of the controversies that surround the island, sifting through historical accounts, scientific experiments and academic opinion. It's a journey that takes us to the tropical Bahamas, Miami, Santorini and to an archaeological site on Crete, as we untangle the past to discover the real story of Atlantis.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Crystal Skulls - mysterious artefacts found around the world that have captured the imagination of new age enthusiasts and esteemed academics alike. One skull in particular has long been the source of controversy and intrigue. The Truth Behind Crystal Skulls looks specifically at the provenance of the Mitchell-Hedges Crystal Skull, claimed to have been discovered in Belize in the early 20th Century. The program answers the questions that continue to mystify its proponents. Is it a contemporary object of art? Is it an ancient Mayan artefact dating to over 3000 years ago? This adventurous documentary finds the answers by delving in to the murky past of the skull and taking us on a journey through the streets of Beijing, the jungle of Belize and the cities of Washington DC and London UK to discover the truth.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Failure in any single department can have major consequences across the whole airport. This episode follows an emergency in air traffic control that leads to a runway closure, a huge task to re-number every departure gate in the airport while it is operational, and the mounting tension on the building site of a new $3.2 billion terminal extension - built specifically to accommodate the A380, the world's biggest passenger airliner.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Among the daily challenges for the 60,000 staff who keep the airport on track and on time: Duty Manager Khalil has to help a family stranded in the terminal because they missed their flight but cant afford to buy new tickets; Service Controller Nargis must free a cargo of meat thats shifted during a flight and is now stuck in the desert heat; and CEO of Dubai Aviation Engineering Projects Suzanne Al Anani is racing to complete the new $3.2 billion Concourse A with a crucial inspection by a member of the emirates royal family just a week away.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: A new plane park has been created to house a fleet of Boeing 777s during the airport's 80 day, billion dollar runway upgrade project, but there is a massive slope to get in and out of it. Pushback Operator Mark Dearden's skills are put to the test as he finds out if he can tow a 300 ton plane down the entry slope without careering out of control. Customs Officers find five huge packages hidden in the bottom of a passenger's luggage. If the powder inside tests positive for heroin, it'll be the biggest drugs haul at the airport in 10 years. And Line Maintenance Engineer Andy Tetley is called onto a plane with a defunct air conditioning system and a temperature of over 110 degrees. He has only a few hours to find out what is wrong and cool it down before it's due to take off.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered where your morality comes from? Is it ingrained in your brain, set by religion, or does society dictate what you deem as right or wrong? Through a series of interactive games and experiments, we'll test the strength of your moral fiber. Play along and discover how your brain makes countless moral decisions every single day. We're going to mess with your mind as we show you how outside influences like clothing, attitude, and your own evolutionary survival may sway your brain...and your morals.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and trust. Does it sometimes seem like you have to be on your guard all the time against untrustworthy advertisers, politicians, and other people? So how do you maintain a level of trust in an untrustworthy world - and what is trust anyway? Through a series of fun and interactive games, you'll learn to trust others a little more and your own brain a little less! Prepare to put your trust in Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Our experts examine the brain's internal tug of war between fear and rationalization. Whether boarding an airplane or walking down a spooky street at night, we'll see how dread and anticipation build feelings of fear. Putting our host's emotions to the test, Apollo Robbins challenges Jason Silva to a game of Russian roulette. Then, with the help of John Harlacher, co-director of one of New York City's scariest haunted houses, we "Fear Factor" a group of volunteers. Without their senses of sight, sound, or control of their limbs, see how they react to snakes, cockroaches and rats... or so they think.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: As winter approaches in Port Protection, residents must be prepared or face dire consequences. Open deer season provides Gary Muehlberger with an opportunity to stockpile meat for the season ahead. Stuart Andrews and Dave Squibb combine to fish for halibut to fill their freezers. In the wake of Jethro's passing, Curly Leech trains a new dog for life in Southeast Alaska. And Mary Miller faces her fears to harvest firewood for the coming winter.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The worst aviation disaster in Florida's history occurred on May 11, 1996. ValuJet Flight 592 mysteriously crashed into the alligator-infested swamps of the Everglades, killing all 110 aboard. Had the FAA implemented safety regulations instated after a similar crash eight years earlier, the tragedy would never have happened. Follow the investigation that would outrage a nation, cost the Secretary of Transportation and an FAA administrator their jobs, and ultimately doom ValuJet Airlines.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Determined airport workers across the country strive to reunite passengers with a curious assortment of lost items, including a prosthetic eye, an espresso machine, a $5000 Gucci bag and a family's beloved heirloom gold Rolex watch. At Philadelphia's International Airport, experts from the zoo arrive with an assortment of animals to help travelers combat the phenomenon known as "airport brain.""

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: An intrepid team of investigators in Denver and Salt Lake City reunites travelers with such lost items as a priceless Native American regalia, a taxidermied rat, a high school wrestling state championship ring, and a fanny pack with a wallet, passport and government IDs. Plus, we head down south to visit Unclaimed Baggage, a store brimming with a plethora of lost airport items shoppers can buy.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through Spain's greatest feats of engineering. From the awe-inspiring technology that's bringing Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Familia to completion, to the secrets of Seville's record-breaking wooden sun shade. Marvel at a gravity-defying skyscraper that seems to hover in the sky, and step back in time as a 2,000-year-old Roman theatre is nursed back to life.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Venture into the heart of Poland's most awe-inspiring engineering marvels. Watch as a super port rises from the depths of the sea, and uncover the secrets behind the tallest building in the European Union. Descend into the shadows beneath Wieliczka, where a sprawling city-sized mine lies hidden, then witness the towering legacy of the world's tallest wooden structure.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Hosted by Phil Keoghan, National Geographic's flagship series Explorer investigates global stories of science, nature and culture. It is the longest-running documentary series on cable and recipient of 52 Emmy Awards, 13 Cable ACE awards, the Genesis and Peabody Awards, and twice nominated for Academy Awards. Newly reformatted as a weekly 1-hour magazine series, episodes air in 171 countries in 45 languages and supported by 440 million viewers.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The world's most famous football team, Manchester United, is on its way back to the UK from the European Championships in Yugoslavia. And after a refueling stop in Munich, the pilots prepare for the final leg of their journey home. In light snow, the aircraft careers down the runway, but just as it approaches takeoff speed, the plane suddenly slows down and, without lifting off the ground, crashes into a nearby house and fuel shed. With 23 people dead, including seven Manchester United players, the high-profile air disaster effectively wipes out one of the best football teams in the world. With the international media clamoring for answers, the German inquiry begins piecing together what went wrong. And when the surviving pilot is blamed for the crash, his struggle to clear his name spans more than a decade and pits one nation against another.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Northwest Airlines Flight #85 Boeing 747-400 Northwest Airlines Flight #85 is halfway between Detroit and Japan's Narita Airport. With more than 400 people on board, the Boeing 747 is cruising 35,000 feet above the Bering Sea when suddenly the aircraft lurches violently to the left and begins losing altitude. The pilots manage to level out the plane but have difficulty controlling the crippled and shaking aircraft. After declaring an emergency, they turn around in the hopes of reaching Anchorage, 1300 kilometers away. Nearly two hours later, the terrifying ordeal ends when the plane touches down safely. The skilled pilots have narrowly saved a 747 from a fatal crash. Now it's up to investigators to determine what caused them to lose control of the plane in the first place.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archaeologists reveal how robbers looted the pyramids and tombs of ancient Egypt, and the clues they left behind. In a necropolis for the elite, they investigate a lavish sunken tomb, raided and reused for centuries. They explore one of the ancient world's most audacious robberies, a daring heist on a giant and heavily protected mastaba tomb. And at Egypt's oldest pyramid, they reveal how builders constructed elaborate defences to protect the treasures within.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Iraq, archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legendary city of Babylon. First discovered in the 1800s, this vast ancient metropolis was home to extraordinary structures and a long line of notorious rulers. Babylon is one of the most famous cities in the Bible, mentioned hundreds of times, from the first book of Genesis to Revelation. But why did it have such a hold over the writers of the Bible? International teams of experts investigate ancient cities across Mesopotamia, which could shed light on this mystery. From the cultural wonders and dramatic history of Nineveh to the extraordinary ziggurat at Dur-Kurigalzu, exploring these sites helps reveal the real world of Babylon and illuminate why it was such a source of inspiration and fascination for the Bible's authors.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Revelation tells of an apocalyptic battle of good versus evil at the end of the world. It says the battle will happen in a place called Armageddon, but Armageddon is no myth. It takes its name from a real ancient settlement: Megiddo. So, what happened here to inspire a Biblical tale of such drama? Archaeologists believe that a series of battles took place here over several centuries, which may have given Megiddo a reputation for violence, turmoil and war as a series of powerful civilizations claimed it as their own. The Egyptians, Assyrians and — according to the Bible — the Israelites all flattened and then rebuilt the city. Finally, it was the site of a battle between King Josiah, the last of the line of King David, and the Egyptians, resulting in Josiah's death. Could these events be the origins of the Armageddon story?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legends of Hercules. Excavators at Olympia uncover a colossal wall that may shed light on the hero's 12 labors. At Gibraltar, investigators explore a mysterious cavern beneath one of the so-called Pillars of Hercules.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the legacy of one of history's most famous figures: Alexander the Great. New discoveries reveal the architectural wonders of Pella in Greece and Ephesus in Turkey; and in Egypt, archaeologists also uncover a skeleton with terrible injuries. Could it hint at the dark side of this golden age?

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Harriet Tubman saw her visions as divine messages from God, giving her the strength not only to liberate herself from the bondage of slavery but also to lead hundreds of other enslaved people to freedom by way of the Underground Railroad. In 2001, a blood-red rain falls over Kerala, inciting fears, superstitions and predictions of an imminent apocalypse. But Kerala is not the first city to experience this macabre downpour. And in ancient Greece, the oracle of Apollo at Didyma prophesied that Alexander the Great would invade and conquer the hulking Persian Empire, changing the course of history fore

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Maccabi - Hapoel TA
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Halastamatu maa
programme.desc: Salajane eriüksuse päästeoperatsioon Lõuna-Filipiinidel muutub julmaks 48-tunniseks ellujäämisvõitluseks. Kui eliitmeeskond satub vaenlase territooriumil varitsuse ohvriks, jääb noore ohvitseri Kinney õlgadele kogu päästeoperatsioon, sest ühtki meest maha ei jäeta. Vastaste õhurünnaku lähenedes ripub Kinney ainus lootus õhujõudude droonipiloodi Reaperil, kelle navigeerimioskusest sõltub, kas järgmine samm võib olla nende viimane.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Batiatus mõtleb välja kavala plaani ning värbab Lucretia, Gaia ja rahulolematuid gladiaatoreid, et see ellu viia. Oenomaus ihkab tagasi saada gladiaatorite kõrgeimat auastet, kuid tema ette kerkivad uued väljakutsed.

programme.title: Püha Vincent
programme.desc: USA 2014 komöödia / draama Lavastaja:Theodore Melfi Osades: Bill Murray, Melissa McCarthy, Naomi Watts Vincent on üks pahur endine sõjaväeveteran, kes saab saatuse tahtel endale uued naabrid - Maggie ja tema 12-aastane adopteeritud poeg, Oliver. Kuid ühel päeval juhtub aga nii, et Oliver naaseb koolist koju, kuhu ta siseneda ei saa, olles oma koduvõtmed ära kaotanud, mispärast pöördub poiss oma "meeldiva" naabri poole palvega lubada tal oodata oma ema tema pool. Kuna Vincent on tegelikult ääreni võlgades, tekib tal idee hakata raha eest Oliverile lapsehoidjaks.Nagu arvatagi võib, on Vincent juba tüdinenud elukogenud mees ning tema lapsehoidmine pole sootukski mitte selline, mida võiks tavapäraseks nimetada, eriti tema elustiili juures, milleks on hasartmängud ja alkohol, ja kindlasti ei tohiks mainimata jätta tema vene rahvusest prostituudist armukest.

programme.title: Clarksoni farm
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkosn kavatseb talutöid mitmekesistada, et suurendada oma aastakasumit (eelmisel aastal vaid 144 naela).

programme.title: Grand Tour
programme.desc: Trio jõuab Šotimaale Invernessi ning valib võrdlemiseks soodsad Itaalia haruldused - Clarkson vaimustub Alfa Romeo GTV6st, May Lancia Gamma Coupe'st ja Hammond Fiat X1/9-st. Koos sõidetakse maanteel, kardirajal ja käänulisel külateel.

programme.title: Täheks sündinud
programme.desc: Täna astuvad vaatajate ette Elvis Presley, Heli Lääts, Britney Spears ja Koit Toome! Kõik see on võimalik üksnes selle kevade kõige vingemas muusikashows, kus täiesti tavalised inimesed kehastuvad vaid üheks õhtuks oma lemmikstaarideks. Parimatest parim võidab finaalis, kuhu pääseb vaid kõige ägedam võistkond, koguni 5000 eurot ja võidukarika. Kohtunikena hindavad shownumbreid hitimeister Stig Rästa, näitleja Peeter Oja, ooperidiiva Elina Nechayeva ning muusikatäht Synne Valtri. Saadet juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Seks ja linn
programme.desc: Megahitist romantiline komöödia, mille aluseks samanimeline menuseriaal. Manhattan, hoia alt! Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte ja Miranda on tagasi, tuues endaga kaasa senisest veelgi keerukamad inimsuhted, efektsemad kostüümid ning rohkem kalleid kingi, kui enamus naisi elu jooksul kanda jõuaks. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Piire ületades
programme.desc: USA 2014 ulmepõnevik Lavastaja: Wally Pfister Osades: Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall, Paul Bettany Dr Will Caster (Johnny Depp) on juhtiv teadlane tehisintellekti valdkonnas, kelle eesmärgiks on luua teadvust omav masin, kes kannaks endas nii kogu inimkonna poolt läbi aegade ammutatud infot kui ka kõiki inimemotsioone. Ta ülimalt vastuolulised katsed on talle kuulsust toonud, ent samas teinud tast ka tehnoloogiavastaste äärmuslaste peamise sihtmärgi. Nood teevad kõik, et teda peatada. Ent püüdes Willi hävitada, sunnivad äärmuslased tahtmatult teda hoopis edu nimel suuremat ohvrit tooma - ta otsustab end katsejänesena üleloomulikuks moondada. Ta naise Evelyni (Rebecca Hall) ja parima sõbra Max Watersi (Paul Bettany) jaoks, kes töötavad mõlemad sama projekti kallal, pole küsimus selles, kas nad suudavad seda teha, vaid selles, kas nad peaksid seda tegema. Nende suurimad kartused saavad tõeks, kui Willi teadmisjanu muutub näiliselt kõikehaaravaks võimuihaks, mille tagajärgi on võimatu ette aimata. Hirmutava tõsiasjana ilmneb vaid see, et teda võib olla võimatu peatada.

programme.title: Kolm reklaamtahvlit linna servas
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2017 draama, komöödia,krimi Lavastaja:Martin McDonagh Osades:Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson, Sam Rockwell, Peter Dinklage, Abbie Cornish, Caleb Landry Jones, John Hawkes Mildred Hayes (Oscari-võitja Frances McDormand) on eluraskuste poolt kõvaks keedetud lahutatud naine, keda piinab päevast päeva Missouri väikelinna Ebbingi politsei tegevusetus. Mildredi teismelise tütre mõrva uurimine pole kuhugi välja viinud ning mitme kuu jooksul pole kinni peetud ainsatki kahtlusalust. Naine paneb kohaliku konnatiigi lainetama, rentides linna toova maantee ääres kolm reklaamtahvlit, mille sisu on otseseks väljakutseks kohalikule korrakaitsele, täpsemalt šerif William Willoughbyle (Woody Harrelson). Kui sündmuste käiku sekkub šerifi parem käsi, ebaküps vägivaldne memmekas Dixon (Sam Rockwell), aitab see konflikti lahendamisele kaasa sama edukalt kui bensiiniga täidetud tulekustuti.

programme.desc: Mike (Channing Tatum) loobus kolme aasta eest strippariametist. Ülejäänud Tampa kuningad on samuti valmis selle ametiga lõpparvet tegema, aga tahavad seda teha omal moel. Nende sooviks on anda viimane vapustav etendus Myrtle Beachis koos legendaarse peaesineja Super-Mike'iga. Mehed asuvad teele ning teevad vahepeatused Jacksonville'is ja Savannah's. Mike ja semud õpivad mõningaid uusi liigutusi ja saavad üllataval moel minevikutaagast lahti. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Grand Tour
programme.desc: May sõidab Floridasse ning meenutab astronautide autosid läbi aegade. Hammond testib uut Aston Martin V8 Vantage'it. Clarkson paneb proovile Citroën C3 Aircrossi ning tõestab, et see on avar, praktiline ja parem kui elevant.

programme.title: Batman vs Superman: Õigluse koidik
programme.desc: Kultuslik fantaasiamärul! Auhinnatud linaloos on ühele pildile mahutatud kaks suursugust kultuskangelast - Batman ja Superman. Kartes, et keegi ei kontrolli jumalat meenutava superkangelase tegusid, astub Gotham City hirmuäratav ja võimas õigusemõistja ise vastu suurlinna kõrgesti austatud kaasaegsele päästjale, kuni ülejäänud maailm püüab selgusele jõuda, millist kangelast nad tegelikult vajavad. Samal ajal kui Batman ja Superman on omavahel sõjajalal, kerkib esile uus hädaoht, mis seab inimkonna suuremasse ohtu kui kunagi varem.

programme.title: A-Rühm
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on neli meest, kes sõdisid Vietnamis ning kellele esitati valesüüdistus. Meestejõuku hüütakse A-rühmaks ning kui nende ülemus Morrison suri, otsustasid nad põgeneda. Nüüdsest pühendab rühm suurema osa oma ajast hädasolevate inimeste aitamiseks. Nad abistavad inimesi, keda koheldakse ebaõiglaselt, päästavad röövimise ohvreid, paljastavad kuritegelikke jõuke ning takistavad kurikaeltel oma plaane teostamast. Kuuldused A-rühma olemasolust jõuavad ajalehereporter Amy Allenini. Ta püüab nendega ühendust võtta ja satub seikluste keerisesse.

programme.title: Vaikiv vennaskond
programme.desc: 1983. USA loodeosa elanikke hirmutavad aina vägivaldsemad pangaröövid ja soomusautode vargused. Üksik FBI-agent jõuab veendumusele, et kuritegude taga pole traditsioonilised, rahaliselt motiveeritud kurjategijad, vaid radikaalsed terroristid.

programme.title: Oceani 11 - kõrged panused
programme.desc: Kassahitist põnevuskomöödia vilunud sulist Danny Oceanist, kes kavandab tõelist "sajandi röövi". Ocean tuleb hullumeelsele ideele röövida ühe õhtuga paljaks kolm Las Vegase suurimat kasiinot, mille turvasüsteemid on maailma parimad. Selleks vajab ta aga oma ala parimaid proffe eesotsas kaardivõlur Rustyga. Tundub, et kümnest mehest peaks plaani õnnestumiseks piisama…

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Mässulised saavad uudiseid kellegi kohta, kellest nad hoolivad ning Spartacus peab otsustama, kas ühe inimese päästmine on väärt riskimist paljude eludega.

programme.title: Viimane hingetõmme
programme.desc: Emotsionaalne põnevik "Viimane hingetõmme" jutustab uskumatu tõestisündinud loo tuukrist Chris Lemonsist, kes jääb õnnetuse käigus Põhjamere põhja lõksu. Tal jagub hapnikku vaid kümneks minutiks ja päästjad ei jõua temani ka poole tunni jooksul. programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Paris - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Kuigi Matthes tahab kuritegelikust maailmast eemale hoida, otsustab ta riskida ja seekord veel kurjategijatega koostööd teha.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Ben ja Semir peavad kaitsma rikast seltskonnadaami Sarah't, keda ähvardatakse röövida. Viimane osutub väga tujukaks ja ajab terve tiimi närvi. Kui selgub, et keegi Sarah' lähikondsetest on röövi organiseerimisega seotud, algab võidujooks ajaga.

programme.title: Kutsuge McCall
programme.desc: Bishop pöördub McCalli meeskonna poole abi saamiseks, kui keegi tema minevikust avastab ta täiskasvanud poja isiku. Tädi Vi tunneb nostalgiat endise romantilise suhte järele, kui ootamatu külaline saabub külla.

programme.title: Kutsuge McCall
programme.desc: McCall ja Mel aitavad küüditatud naisel leida oma poega pärast seda, kui nad USA piiril varjupaika otsides üksteises lahutati. Mel, McCall ja Bishop kasutavad kõiki võimalusi, et Harryt vanglast vabastada.

programme.title: Kättemaks
programme.desc: Suurbritannia / USA 2018 märul Lavastaja:Brian A. Miller Osades: Bruce Willis, Frank Grillo, Johnathon Schaech Vägivaldses pangaröövis kolleegi kaotanud pangajuht Jacob (Frank Grillo) ühendab jõud eksvõmmist naabri James'iga (Bruce Willis), et panka röövinud kurikael kättemaksuks kinni nabida.

programme.title: Mannergute Mõõduvõtt
programme.desc: Mannergute Mõõduvõtt on meeskondlik, meelelahutuslik, mitte-sportlik kestvussõit, mille põhiliseks eesmärgiks on tuua kokku sõbrad, kes saaksid mitte liiga pingelises olukorras nautida pikka sõidutesti mitte liiga kalli ega kiire autoga.

programme.title: Roimavennad
programme.desc: Politseiuurijatest vennad Ali ja Leo pole aastakümneid omavahel rääkinud. Kuid kui nad satuvad ootamatult rahvusvahelisse vandenõusse, peavad täiesti erineva iseloomuga vennad taas koostööd tegema.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Howard saab teate, et füüsikaolümpiaadil on vaba koht ühele võistkonnale ja mehed haaravad võimalusest kinni. Kui Sheldon vastab proovi käigus kõikidele küsimustele, jäetakse ta võistkonnast kõrvale ja Leslie Winkle on nõus tema asemel osalema. Sheldon paneb kokku oma võistkonna, kuigi ta on ainus, kes küsimustele vastata oskab.

programme.title: Kalamehejutud
programme.desc: Saate Kalamehejutud peamiseks eesmärgiks on tutvustada erinevate kalaliikide püüdmiseks vajalikke vahendeid, nippe ja kalastuskohti. Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Saatejuhid on Kalev Kruus ja Vladislav Korzets.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad
programme.desc: Thord näeb vaeva veoauto päästmisega, samal ajal kui kannatamatud juhid ta elu ohtu seavad. Tor Steinar saab oma lumesaha uuesti liikuma. Sitigi päästmine muutub veelgi keerulisemaks, kui osa veoauto varustusest ei tööta.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad
programme.desc: Aega napib ja politsei suurendab survet, kui Thordil on raskusi veoauto teele tagasi saamisega. Teelt maha sõitnud leivaauto tekitab Stigile ja Vidarile raske väljakutse. Ole Hendrik viib Mareni ta esimesele päästemissioonile.

programme.title: Ekstreemne ellujäämine: võimas Mekongi jõgi
programme.desc: Hazen Audel alustab kõrgel pilvede kohal erakordset ellujäämisseiklust. Ta laskub Laose Mekongi vesikonna kõrgeimast punktist läbi pilvemetsa, otsides hmongi rahvast, kes jahib traditsioonilisi mürke kasutades, ja meisterdab Vietnami sõja šrapnellidest ellujäämiseks vajalikke tööriistu. Lõpuks otsib ta üles võimsa Mekongi jõe, kust ta loodab oma 800 km pikkusele rännakule õnnistust leida.

programme.title: Rait, Raivo ja naised teel Iraani
programme.desc: Reisisellid liiguvad Lõuna-Iraanist tagasi põhja poole ning alles nüüd avaneb seltskonnal võimalus näha kaunist Pärsia arhitektuuri ilu - mudast majad ning lossid võtavad eestlastel sõnad suust. Iraan ei valmista oma külalislahkuse osas pettumust ning kohaliku abiga saab tee joomise kõrvalt broneeritud põnev hotell liivadüünide ääres, kuhu ka hilisõhtuks jõutakse. Hotell on samuti nagu ehtsas kunagises Pärsias - suur mudast ja põhust ruum, kuhu kaetakse laud kombekohaselt vaibale.

programme.title: Rait, Raivo ja naised teel Iraani
programme.desc: Reisiseltskond ärkab iidses mudahotellis ning läheb õue avastama, millised on need liivadüünid, kuhu automehed nii kangesti jõuda tahavad. Päeva edenedes tüütab Raiti pikk asfaltee ära ning ta otsustab proovida mõnda huvitavamat teed. Tunnid hiljem saame teada, et suund, mis Rait võttis on vale ja isegi keelatud. Õhtul linnas laagrivarusid täiendades eskorditakse meid kõiki aga politseijaoskonda..

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Leonard teeb oksjonil pakkumise väikese ajamasina peale ning võidabki selle. Kui masin kohale tuuakse, pole see sugugi nii väike ja mehed teevad seda üles tassides endile viga. Penny meelest on nad haledad, et sellisele asjale nii palju aega raiskavad, aga see haavab Leonardi tundeid ja ta viskab kõik oma nohiklikud asjad ära.

programme.title: Vääritu sõjapidamise ministeerium
programme.desc: "Vääritu sõjapidamise ministeerium" jutustab uskumatu ja seni kuulmata tõestisündinud loo esimesest eriüksusest, mille asutasid II maailmasõja päevil ÜK peaminister Winston Churchill ja veel mõned sõjaväe ametnikud, kelle seas oli ka kirjanik Ian Fleming. Isepäistest sõduritest koosnev ülisalajane üksus asus natsidega võitlusse täiesti tavatuid ja äärmiselt väärituid võtteid kasutades. Nende julge lähenemine muutis sõja kulgu ja pani aluse Briti SAS-ile ja tänapäevastele salaoperatsioonidele.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: David Soul proovis kätt mõistliku hinnaga auto roolis ja üritas võimalikult mitu Lianat hunnikusse sõita, ent sai hakkama vaid kahega. Richard istub Lexus SC430 rooli ja Jeremy proovib ära Volkswagen Touaregi, arutledes selle üle, kas auto on ikka oma hinda väärt. Toonust tõstetakse Jaguar XJS-il ja ära proovitakse ka Perodua Kelisa. Jeremy istub BMW Z8 rooli, mille maine on saanud tublisti kannatada seetõttu, et sama marki auto on ka Ronan Keatingil.

programme.title: Kutsuge McCall
programme.desc: McCall püüab leida sarimõrvari poolt röövitud naist, kelle varasemad kuriteod jäid avastamata. McCalli ootavad ees probleemid, kui ta satub oma valvsa tegevuse tõttu Manhattani ringkonnaprokuröri Avery Graftoni radarile.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Jaoskonnas jätkub vallandamislaine. Noor korrumpeerunud juhataja paljastab järjest julgemini oma tõelist palet ja sahkerdab Urmase abil jaoskonna rahadega. Rein on Hans-Kristjani vallandamise pärast endast väljas ja läheb juhatajaga avalikult karvu pidi kokku. Nüüd tuleb tõsiselt tegutsema hakata, et kiuslikust juhatajast vabaneda ja oma töökoht säilitada. Reinu kodune olukord on uuesti kriisis ja ta peab Hans-Kristjanilt öömaja paluma. Sile heidab Hans-Kristjani pruudile silma ja Relika läheb oma naabri juurde üllatusterohkele õhtusöögile. Riigikogulaste röövimise juhtumis toimub aga dramaatiline areng.

programme.title: Ment

Rein on Hans-Kristjani vallandamise pärast endast väljas ja läheb juhatajaga avalikult karvu pidi kokku. Nüüd tuleb tõsiselt tegutsema hakata, et kiuslikust juhatajast vabaneda ja oma töökoht säilitada. Reinu kodune olukord on uuesti kriisis ja ta peab Hans-Kristjanilt öömaja paluma. Sile heidab Hans-Kristjani pruudile silma ja Relika läheb oma naabri juurde üllatusterohkele õhtusöögile. Riigikogulaste röövimise juhtumis toimub aga dramaatiline areng.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika leiavad juhuslikult esimese röövitud riigikogulase üles ja erakordses juhtumis oodatakse nüüd kiiret läbimurret. Noor juhataja ja salakaval Urmas planeerivad aga jaoskonnas veelgi drastilisemaid muudatusi läbi viia ja Rein üritab koos endise juhatajaga ministeeriumist liitlasi leida. Hans-Kristjan saab teada, et kolleeg Sile on salaja tema pruudiga kohtunud ja jaoskonnas läheb tõeliseks madinaks. Relika kohtub viimaks oma unelmate mehega ja Rein satub koos ministrinõunikuga kummalisele saunapeole.

Päeva edenedes tüütab Raiti pikk asfaltee ära ning ta otsustab proovida mõnda huvitavamat teed. Tunnid hiljem saame teada, et suund, mis Rait võttis on vale ja isegi keelatud. Õhtul linnas laagrivarusid täiendades eskorditakse meid kõiki aga politseijaoskonda..

programme.title: Kutsuge McCall
programme.desc: McCall püüab leida sarimõrvari poolt röövitud naist, kelle varasemad kuriteod jäid avastamata. McCalli ootavad ees probleemid, kui ta satub oma valvsa tegevuse tõttu Manhattani ringkonnaprokuröri Avery Graftoni radarile.

programme.title: Roimavennad

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: David Soul proovis kätt mõistliku hinnaga auto roolis ja üritas võimalikult mitu Lianat hunnikusse sõita, ent sai hakkama vaid kahega. Richard istub Lexus SC430 rooli ja Jeremy proovib ära Volkswagen Touaregi, arutledes selle üle, kas auto on ikka oma hinda väärt. Toonust tõstetakse Jaguar XJS-il ja ära proovitakse ka Perodua Kelisa. Jeremy istub BMW Z8 rooli, mille maine on saanud tublisti kannatada seetõttu, et sama marki auto on ka Ronan Keatingil.

programme.title: Driftides Euroopa meistriks

programme.title: Resident tulnukas
programme.desc: Humoorikas ulmesari Maal hädamaandunud tulnukast Harryst, kes peab salamissiooni jätkamiseks kehastuma Colorado väikelinna arstiks. Inimestega lähemal tutvumisel seisab ta aga moraalse dilemma ees - kas inimkond ikkagi väärib hävitamist?

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Leonard teeb oksjonil pakkumise väikese ajamasina peale ning võidabki selle. Kui masin kohale tuuakse, pole see sugugi nii väike ja mehed teevad seda üles tassides endile viga. Penny meelest on nad haledad, et sellisele asjale nii palju aega raiskavad, aga see haavab Leonardi tundeid ja ta viskab kõik oma nohiklikud asjad ära.

Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Saatejuhid on Kalev Kruus ja Vladislav Korzets.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad
programme.desc: Aega napib ja politsei suurendab survet, kui Thordil on raskusi veoauto teele tagasi saamisega. Teelt maha sõitnud leivaauto tekitab Stigile ja Vidarile raske väljakutse. Ole Hendrik viib Mareni ta esimesele päästemissioonile.

programme.title: Jääraja päästjad

programme.desc: Ellujäämiskunsti ekspert Hazen Audel seikleb sügavale iidsetesse Laose metsadesse, otsides hooajalisi seeni, mida väärtustavad kohalikud hõimud. Pärast mitu kuud kestnud vihmaperioodi on rikkumatud, iidsed metsad looduslikest aaretest pungil. Parimate seenealadeni jõudmiseks peab Hazen aga üle elama elamiskõlbmatu kõnnumaa ja toime tulema mitme jõhkra katsumusega.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Selle nädala teema on Jaguarid. Jeremy katsetab uut XJR-i ja tahab näha, kaua ta suudab sõita, enne kui tal igav hakkab. James sõidab 1950ndatest pärit C-Type'iga ja Richardile jääb 1960ndate Mark II. Saatekülaline on parlamendisaadik Boris Johnson.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika toovad väljakutselt jaoskonda eksootilise külalise kaasa. Noor juhataja hakkab kannatust kaotama ja salakaval Urmas hakkab oma seljataguse pärast muretsema. Rein tahab naisega ära leppida, kuid peab siis hoopis Relikalt öömaja paluma ja paneb sellega Relika uue suhte proovile. Rein ja Hans-Kristjan saavad aga tõuke riigikogulaste kadumise juhtumi lahendamiseks, samal ajal kui kõik jaoskonna töötajad saavad korraga vallandamiskäskkirja. Reinul pole nüüd enam midagi kaotada.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika saab oma ukraina kavalerilt ootamatu ettepaneku, mis sunnib Relikat kogu oma elu ümber hindama. Reinu ja noore juhataja suhe teravneb veelgi, kuid Hans-Krisjanil on idee, kuidas sundida Urmast uue juhataja vastu tunnistusi andma - ehk suudab see trikk jaoskonna päästa? Reinu poeg korraldab Reinule ja Reinu naisele üllatusliku kohtingu, kus nad saavad lõpuks oma suhte sasipuntra lahti harutada. Riigikogu liikmete röövimise juhtum võtab aga ootamatult uue dramaatilise pöörde.

Jaoskonnas on tänu uue juhataja korruptsioonijuhtumile kõik pea peale pööratud ja skandaali tuleb summutama tähtis külaline ministeeriumist. programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Samal ajal on Reinu naine saanud rahvusvahelise firma osakonnajuhiks ja käitub kodus Reinuga nagu oma alluvaga.
